🧺 Thematic baskets主题篮子

as of截至 —

Equal-weight US theme baskets measured against the S&P 500. Use them to see which themes are leading or fading.等权重美国主题篮子，对标标普 500。用于观察哪些主题在走强或走弱。

★✅ What to act on now现在该做什么 buy now · wait for a pullback · reduce / avoid立即买入 · 等待回调 · 减仓回避

Shortlist by action: buy now, wait for a pullback, or reduce / avoid. Click a theme to see the stocks.按操作分类：立即买入、等待回调、减仓/回避。点击主题查看成分股。

★🧭 Theme Rotation Desk主题轮动台 scored · labeled · actionable评分 · 标注 · 可执行

Each theme gets a 0-100 score, a label, and an action read based on trend, breadth, impulse, macro and crowding.每个主题按趋势、广度、脉冲、宏观和拥挤度给出 0-100 分、标签和操作结论。

★🛑 Market concentration & theme leadership市场集中度与主题领导力 who owns the advance vs the decline谁主导上涨 vs 谁在下跌

Shows whether leadership is broad or narrow, which themes own the advance, and which ones are rolling over.显示行情是广泛还是集中，哪些主题主导上涨，哪些正在回落。

★📆 5-Day Theme Rotation5日主题轮动 weekly climbers & fallers本周上升与下降

Weekly movers ranked by 5-day return versus S&P 500, plus the change in 20-day relative-strength rank.按相对标普 500 的 5 日回报排名，并显示 20 日相对强度排名变化。

★⚡ Impulse & Extremes脉冲与极值 across the thematic universe覆盖全部主题成分

Daily breadth across basket members: big movers and new 52-week highs or lows.篮子成分的日内广度：大幅波动和 52 周新高/新低。

00🌐 Flow lens — where rotation is concentrating资金流透视 — 轮动集中在哪里 display-only仅展示

Shows where cross-sectional flow is clustering. Focus tool, not a forecast.显示横截面资金正在集中在哪里。用于聚焦，不是预测。

What this is &amp; how it was validated这是什么 · 如何验证

Descriptive detector of where flow is clustering across sectors and theme baskets. Read quality measures data coherence, not directional confidence. Use it to focus research; it is not scored.这是描述性探测器，用来观察行业和主题篮子中的资金集中位置。读数质量衡量数据一致性，不是方向置信度。用于聚焦研究，不参与评分。 validation meta验证元数据

01Performance table表现一览

Sortable snapshot of every basket. Toggle between raw return, return versus S&P 500, and each basket's own z-score. Click a basket to see members.所有篮子的可排序快照。可切换原始回报、相对标普 500 回报和篮子自身 z 分数。点击篮子查看成分。
